item.title: SCP-5762:
item.content:encoded:
" Patient died on operating table. :( "
Oh man that got me.

I really enjoyed this, although if I could make a couple of recommendations:

- maybe make the first test after the dummy a D-class? I was pretty shocked to see them skip right to agents given it's something picked up via MC&D. I know a few tests were skipped so it could have been done in there, but that strikes me as an important benchmark. We wouldn't even have to intentionally mangle a D class, they're probably more frequently in need of surgery than agents by nature.

- it becomes pretty clear early on that it's developing emotions: maybe we could include how it's co-surgeons feel about *it* (or its work), especially the director beyond just a recommendation that it be allowed to work independently.

- I know you probably want to retain the emotional punch of it shutting down forever, but I do think that the foundation would probably have a contingency in case it does ever boot back up. Maybe a suggestion of therapy with a counselor specializing in sentient SCPs?

item.title: SCP-5196: How to add an image
item.content:encoded:
Ok so you seem to be having trouble inserting an image, let me help you.

So first near the discuss tab there will be a file tab click on it, this is where you can upload the image you want to use. Then once you have uploaded the image your going to have to insert this code

[[include component:image-block | name=THE NAME OF YOUR IMAGE FILE | caption=THE TEXT UNDERNEATH THE IMAGE | width=WIDTH-GOES-HERE]]

From the looks of things im assuming your new to the site? If so please read How To Write An SCP it is amazing for new users. Have a good day :)

item.title: SCP-4494:
item.content:encoded:
I really liked this one. A simple and quick yet interesting read. I noticed some people don't like that the character is one-dimensional but I think that fits very well because that's the point. He's supposed to be the embodiment of fighting crime so it makes sense for him to be all-good and bent on stopping evil-doers. After all when the criminals are put down he himself disappears because his job is done. To me the Specter is like the Batman of the SCP universe and I like it. It's refreshing to see an SCP that isn't evil or causes terrible effects.

The only thing not to my taste is the conversation between the foundation agents and the SCP where it starts using slang and talk about video games. I feel like it would fit better if he sounded more like a professional and less like a teenager.

I recommend reading the article with The Dark Knight Main Theme playing in the background, it's pretty epic.

+1
